verdicts.reason: A keeps every text block clear of the image and readable, but the middle image has a meaningless empty white card with the two pink dots stranded inside it, which looks like content is missing. COOPER also nearly touches the image edge and the date line is small. B shows the graphic cleanly, but 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' runs into the image edge. The date wraps awkwardly ('10:00 AM' on its own line) and starts right at the image boundary, the pill butts against the image, and the pink dots are scattered at random (one beside DEAN, one at the far right edge). B's collisions and loose pieces are worse than A's single empty-card flaw.
